keyFindings.description: The controller's command read one unpaged page of 200 events, oldest first, while the rule it now applies (the newest add transition) and the daemon (intake.LabelSetter over EventsAfter from 0) read the whole log; on a root with more than 200 events whose label was removed and set again late, the two could name different setters. Fixed by the reviewer in 3f22ff3869b12001d80e02c4ff62fc8523ac30f8: the command's sentence says to page with &after=<last seq> until a page holds fewer than 200. Prose only; A5's greps and packages/pi-legion/src/skills-guard.test.ts (13 pass) re-run on the edited file.

The delivery guard is read-then-write: GetIssue, then SetStatus with no expected_sequence (dispatch/client.go:125-133), where HandOver fences on LastSeq (client.go:142-147). A park between the two round trips is overwritten. Pre-existing for every status row; the spec's R4 asks for the re-read and nothing more. Not a defect; named as a risk in the PR body.

A pending personHandover row is undecodable to a daemon before this release (DecodeOutboxPayload uses DisallowUnknownFields): a rollback while one is pending retries that row until it is removed, holding that issue's later status rows behind it. Window: the seconds a row is pending. A deploy note, not code.

The code-quality pass asked to share the queue-and-log sequence between admit.queuePersonHandover and workflow.dispatchArtifact and to have personHandoverQueues return the write rather than a bool. Judged not a defect: six lines in two packages with different enqueue wrapping and commit-log hooks (intake.OnCommit, Engine.logOnCommit); the nil-view guard sits in personHandoverQueues and the dereference runs only when it returned true; the shared message literal is asserted by the scratch proof. The implementer's simplify pass declined the same helper for the same reason.

notDefects: A label added by the same PATCH that closes an issue is skipped by intake.LabelSetter (issue.closed is not walked): matches R2's rule as the spec states it, pinned by intake/label_setter_test.go; a session gains nothing it cannot do today by writing todo beside the label.

The carry prefix literal (intake.CarriedApprovalReasonPrefix) is pinned on the producer side by packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/api/approval_carry_test.go:233 (carrySentence), so a reword of carryReason fails an envoy test.

One full event-log read per issue.* event of an unrecorded labelled triage root and per boot-listing row of one is the spec's own Limits section; the read is outside the fact's transaction and bounded by AckWait.
